````
- ui → model (and feature-local state when justified)
- data → model
- model → pure TypeScript, no Angular dependencies
````

```
# Architecture Rules

## Dependency Directions

- `app` may import from `core`, `shared`, and `features`.
- `core` may import from `shared` only.
- `features/<name>` may import from `shared` only, and from another feature only through that feature's `index.ts`.
- `shared` imports from no other layer in `src/app`.
- Forbidden: `features` to `core`, `core` to `features`, `shared` to `core` or `features`.

## Public API

- Import a module only through its `index.ts`, using its alias. Never import a deep file such as `features/deals/pages/...`.
- Inside one module, relative imports are allowed.
- Lazy routes load a feature through its alias, for example `import('@feature/deals')` (ADR-0004).

## Path Aliases

Defined in the `paths` of `tsconfig.json`.

| Alias             | Target                             |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `@core`           | `src/app/core/index.ts`            |
| `@shared`         | `src/app/shared/index.ts`          |
| `@feature/<name>` | `src/app/features/<name>/index.ts` |

- Alias names are fixed: `@core`, `@shared`, and `@feature/<name>`, where `<name>` is the feature folder name in kebab-case. Do not invent other aliases without the user's approval.
- Do not use wildcard mappings such as `@feature/*`. Sheriff reports them as SH-001 errors, so each feature has its own explicit entry.
- Across a module boundary, use the alias. Do not use `../` paths. For example, from `features/deals/` to shared code, use `@shared`, not `../../../shared`.
- Relative imports are allowed only inside the same module: the same `core`, the same `shared`, or the same `features/<name>` folder.
```

```
# Angular Rules

## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking
- Prefer type inference when the type is obvious
- Avoid the `any` type; use `unknown` when type is uncertain

## Angular Best Practices

- Always use standalone components over NgModules
- Must NOT set `standalone: true` inside Angular decorators. It's the default in Angular v20+.
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly. `OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+.
- Use signals for state management
- Implement lazy loading for feature routes
- Do NOT use the `@HostBinding` and `@HostListener` decorators. Put host bindings inside the `host` object of the `@Component` or `@Directive` decorator instead
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images.
  - `NgOptimizedImage` does not work for inline base64 images.

## Accessibility Requirements

- It MUST pass all AXE checks.
- It MUST follow all WCAG AA minimums, including focus management, color contrast, and ARIA attributes.

## Components

- Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility
- Use `input()` and `output()` functions instead of decorators
- Use `model()` for two-way bound properties with `[(prop)]` syntax instead of pairing `input()` with `output()`
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Use `linkedSignal()` for state derived from multiple reactive sources that must stay synchronized
- Expose visual variant dimensions as literal union inputs (for example `input<'new' | 'won'>()`) reflected to the DOM with `[attr.data-<name>]` in the `host` in @Component()
```

```
# Workflow Rules

## Code Generation

- Never create files by hand that an `ng g` schematic can generate.
- `ng g c <path>` already creates a folder named after the last segment. Pass the parent folder, not the folder plus name: `ng g c shared/badge` (creates `shared/badge/badge.ts`), not `ng g c shared/badge/badge` (creates `shared/badge/badge/badge.ts`).
- Do not change schematic flags unless the user asks. Let defaults come from `angular.json`.
- Prefer batch generation: prepare all needed `ng g` commands first, then run them together in one terminal call.

## Verification Order

- Format changed files with prettier: `npx prettier --write <files>`. Config is in `.prettierrc`.
- Type-check with `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json`.
- Lint changed files only: `npx eslint <files>`.
- Use the running `ng serve` session to check the build. Do not run `ng build` unless asked. If no session is running, ask before starting one.
- Fix only problems in changed files, or problems that stop `ng serve` from rebuilding.
- The editor's CSS linter reports `@theme` and `@apply` as errors. These are false positives from Tailwind at-rules.

## Browser Checks

- Ask before using `open_browser_page`, `click_element`, or any other browser tool to verify, debug, or fix.

## Scope

- Template-only requests: do not add logic beyond the `imports` array unless the user approves.
- Do not create markdown files to document changes unless requested.
```

```
import { HttpErrorResponse, HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject, InjectionToken } from '@angular/core';

export const API_URL = new InjectionToken('API_URL', {
  factory: () => 'http://localhost:3000/api/', // TODO: enviroment.ts
});

export const Auth = new InjectionToken('Auth', {
  factory: () => ({
    getToken: () => 'mock-access-u1',
  }),
});

export const URLInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  if (req.url.match(/^https?:/)) return next(req);

  const url = inject(API_URL); // Lazy

  return next(
    req.clone({
      url: url + req.url,
    }),
  );
};

export const AuthInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) => {
  if (req.headers.has('Authorization')) return next(req);

  const auth = inject(Auth); // Lazy

  return next(
    req.clone({
      setHeaders: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${auth.getToken()}`,
        // 'X-Tajne': '123',
      },
    }),
  );
};

      count: 3,
      delay(error, retryCount) {
        const RETRYABLE_HTTP_CODES = [
          0, // No response
```

```
import { Router } from 'express';
import { store } from '../store.js';
import { authMiddleware } from '../middleware/auth.js';

const router = Router();

router.use(authMiddleware);

/**
 * GET /contacts?q=&offset=&limit=
 * Search contacts by name, email, or company.
 */
router.get('/', (req, res) => {
  const q = req.query.q as string | undefined;
  const offset = parseInt(req.query.offset as string) || 0;
  const limit = parseInt(req.query.limit as string) || 20;

  const result = store.searchContacts(q, offset, limit);
  res.json({ contacts: result });
});

/**
 * GET /contacts/check-email?email=
 * Returns { exists: boolean } — used by async form validators.
 * MUST be registered before /:contactId to avoid route collision.
 */
router.get('/check-email', (req, res) => {
  const email = req.query.email as string;

  if (!email) {
    res.status(400).json({
      error: { status: 400, message: 'Email query parameter is required', code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR' },
    });
    return;
  }

  res.json({ exists: store.checkEmail(email) });
});

/**
 * GET /contacts/:contactId
 * Get a single contact by ID.
 */
router.get('/:contactId', (req, res) => {
  const contact = store.getContact(req.params.contactId);

  if (!contact) {
    res.status(404).json({
      error: { status: 404, message: 'Contact not found', code: 'NOT_FOUND' },
    });
    return;
  }

  res.json(contact);
});

export default router;
```
</details></tool-use>

```
// ─── Contact ──────────────────────────────────────────

export type ContactStatus = 'lead' | 'prospect' | 'customer' | 'churned';

export interface Contact {
  id: string;
  firstName: string;
  lastName: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  company: string;
  status: ContactStatus;
  avatarUrl: string;
  notes: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// ─── Deal ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type DealStage = 'new' | 'negotiation' | 'proposal' | 'closed-won' | 'closed-lost';

/** API response shape — does NOT include tasks. */
export interface Deal {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  value: number;
  stage: DealStage;
  description: string;
  contactId: string;
  public: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

/** Internal storage shape — includes embedded tasks. */
export interface DealRecord extends Deal {
  tasks: Task[];
}

export interface DealUpdateRequest {
  title?: string;
  value?: number;
  stage?: DealStage;
  description?: string;
  contactId?: string;
  public?: boolean;
}

// ─── Task ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TaskPriority = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';

export interface Task {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  dueDate: string;
  priority: TaskPriority;
  completed: boolean;
}

export interface TaskCreateRequest {
  title: string;
  dueDate?: string;
  priority?: TaskPriority;
}

export interface TaskUpdateRequest {
  title?: string;
  dueDate?: string;
  priority?: TaskPriority;
  completed?: boolean;
}

// ─── Auth ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface LoginRequest {
  email: string;
  password: string;
}

export interface LoginResponse {
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
  expiresIn: number;
}

/** Public user info returned by GET /auth/me. */

  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
```

```
import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import YAML from 'yaml';
import swaggerUi from 'swagger-ui-express';

import authRoutes from './routes/auth.js';
import contactsRoutes from './routes/contacts.js';
import dealsRoutes from './routes/deals.js';
import tasksRoutes from './routes/tasks.js';
import { errorHandler } from './middleware/error.js';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env['PORT'] ?? 3000;

// ─── Global middleware ────────────────────────────────
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());

app.use(async (req, res, next) => {
  await delay(200 + 2000 * Math.random()); // Responses can arrive out of order!
  next();
});

// ─── OpenAPI / Swagger UI ─────────────────────────────
const openapiPath = join(__dirname, '..', 'openapi.yaml');
const openapiDoc = YAML.parse(readFileSync(openapiPath, 'utf-8'));
app.use('/api-docs', swaggerUi.serve, swaggerUi.setup(openapiDoc));

// ─── API routes ───────────────────────────────────────
app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api/contacts', contactsRoutes);
app.use('/api/deals', dealsRoutes);
app.use('/api/deals/:dealId/tasks', tasksRoutes);

// ─── Error handler (must be last) ─────────────────────
app.use(errorHandler as any);

// ─── Start ────────────────────────────────────────────
app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`🚀 CRM API server running at http://localhost:${PORT}/api`);
  console.log(`📖 Swagger UI at http://localhost:${PORT}/api-docs`);
});

export function delay(t = 500): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, t));
}
```

```
## Plan: Contacts feature (search + details)

Add `features/contacts` (lazy route `/contacts`). Search page with signal form, responsive card grid, detail page via router input binding. Store uses HttpClient (Observables), pages wrap them with rxResource. Data comes from the existing server (`server/`, port 3000). Mocks mirror openapi.yaml. Excluded: related deals/tasks, advanced search, create/edit, check-email.

**Steps**

Phase 0 - Wiring (independent)
1. Add `withComponentInputBinding()` to `provideRouter` in src/app/app.config.ts (required for `contactId` and `q` inputs).
2. Add `@feature/contacts` to tsconfig.json paths; add `'src/app/features/contacts': 'feature:contacts'` to sheriff.config.ts modules (no depRules change).
3. Add `{ path: 'contacts', loadChildren: () => import('@feature/contacts').then(m => m.contactsRoutes) }` to src/app/app.routes.ts.
4. Add `{ path: 'contacts/**', renderMode: RenderMode.Client }` to src/app/app.routes.server.ts, before the `**` prerender entry.

Phase 1 - Model and data (depends on 0)
5. `features/contacts/model/contact.model.ts`: `CONTACT_STATUS` const object + `ContactStatus` union (no enums), `Contact` (avatarUrl optional), `ContactSearchPage<T>` (items/total/offset/limit), `CONTACT_STATUS_LABELS`, pure helper for full name.
6. `features/contacts/data/contacts.store.ts`: `@Service()` `ContactsStore`, `inject(HttpClient)`. `search({ q, offset, limit })` -> `get<ContactSearchResponse>('contacts')` -> map `.contacts` (note: envelope differs from deals). `getById(id)` -> `get<Contact>('contacts/${id}')`. Relative URLs; URLInterceptor adds base.
7. `features/contacts/data/contacts-seed.ts`: 4 contacts c1-c4 copied from server/src/data/mock-contacts.ts (see Further Considerations 1).

Phase 2 - Shared and UI (parallel with each other, after 5)
8. `src/app/shared/avatar/avatar.ts`: `Avatar` with inputs `name`, `src` (optional), `size` ('sm'|'md'|'lg'), size set on host `[attr.data-size]` like `Badge`. Shows `img` when src is non-empty, otherwise initials. Domain-free. Export from src/app/shared/index.ts.
9. `features/contacts/ui/contact-status-badge/contact-status-badge.ts`: wraps `Badge` from `@shared`, `input.required<ContactStatus>()`, host `[attr.data-contact-status]`, colors per status (customer green, lead orange, prospect blue, churned red). Mirrors `DealStageBadge`.
10. `features/contacts/ui/contact-card/contact-card.ts`: presentational. Input `contact`, output `contactSelected`. Renders Avatar, name, company, email, status badge.
11. `features/contacts/ui/contact-search-form/contact-search-form.ts`: Signal Forms (`@angular/forms/signals`) with one `q` field, `SharedForms` Material input, Search button. Input initial `q`. Output `queryChange` debounced as the user types.
12. `features/contacts/ui/contact-full-details-card/contact-full-details-card.ts`: input `contact`. Avatar, full name, status badge, company, labeled Email / Phone / Created (DatePipe `longDate`) / Status / Notes. Two columns on md+.

Phase 3 - Pages (depends on 5-12)
13. `features/contacts/pages/contact-search/contact-search.page.ts` (`ContactSearchPage`): input `q` bound from query params. `rxResource` with params `q`, stream `store.search`. Grid `grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2`. Card output navigates to `/contacts/:id`. Form output writes `q` to URL with `replaceUrl: true`. Shows loading and error states.
14. `features/contacts/pages/contact-details/contact-details.page.ts` (`ContactDetailsPage`): `contactId = input.required<string>()`. `rxResource` with params `contactId`, stream `store.getById`. "Back to search" link to `/contacts/search`. Loading, error, and not-found (404) messages. Renders ContactFullDetailsCard.

Phase 4 - Routing (depends on 13-14)
15. `features/contacts/contacts.routes.ts` (default export `Routes`): wrapper route `{ path: '', providers: [ContactsStore], children: [ { path: '', pathMatch: 'full', redirectTo: 'search?q=' }, { path: 'search', loadComponent: ContactSearchPage }, { path: ':contactId', loadComponent: ContactDetailsPage } ] }`. Wrapper providers make one store instance shared by both pages.
16. `features/contacts/index.ts`: `export { default as contactsRoutes } from './contacts.routes';` (only public export).

Phase 5 - Verification (after 16)
17. Run `npm ci` if node_modules is missing (none found in workspace), then `npx prettier --write <changed files>`, `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json`, `npx eslint <changed files>`, and the module-boundaries skill.
18. Start the API (`server/`, port 3000; it adds 0.2-2.2 s random delay, so loading states are visible) and keep `ng serve` running.
19. Manual checks (browser checks only after asking the user): `/contacts` redirects to `/contacts/search?q=`; typing updates `q` in URL after debounce; grid is 1 column on mobile and 2 on md+; `/contacts/c1` loads directly (deep link); unknown id shows not-found; "Back to search" works; avatars show initials when `avatarUrl` is empty; AXE check on both pages.

**Relevant files**
- `src/app/app.config.ts`: add `withComponentInputBinding()` to `provideRouter(routes)`.
- `src/app/app.routes.ts`: add `contacts` lazy route before `**`, same pattern as `deals`.
- `src/app/app.routes.server.ts`: add `contacts/**` as `RenderMode.Client`.
- `tsconfig.json`: add `@feature/contacts` to `paths`.
- `sheriff.config.ts`: add `features/contacts` module entry.
- `src/app/features/contacts/**`: new feature (model, data, ui, pages, routes, index).
- `src/app/shared/index.ts`: export `Avatar`.
- `src/app/shared/avatar/avatar.ts`: new shared component, placed next to `shared/badge/badge.ts`.
- Reuse as reference: `features/deals/data/deals.store.ts` (`@Service`, HttpClient, paging map), `features/deals/pages/deals-list/deals-list.page.ts` (rxResource with params, linkedSignal, URL sync), `features/deals/ui/deal-stage-badge/deal-stage-badge.ts` (badge host data-attr pattern), `shared/badge/badge.ts` (`Badge`, `size` input).
- Contract: `server/openapi.yaml` (`Contact`, `ContactSearchResponse`, `PagingObject_Contact`); server data `server/src/data/mock-contacts.ts`.

**Verification**
1. Prettier, tsc, and ESLint/Sheriff pass for all changed files.
2. Routes, responsive grid, deep link, and not-found behavior checked as in step 19 (after asking before browser tools).

**Decisions**
- Store is provided on the feature wrapper route (scoped, not root). `rxResource` lives in pages; the store returns Observables.
- Feature model is hand-written. Features cannot import `core/model/api.model.ts` (Sheriff: features -> shared only), so it mirrors openapi.yaml.
- Status is a const object, not an enum (`erasableSyntaxOnly`).
- Search sends `q`, `offset=0`, `limit=20`. No pagination UI.
- Avatar shows initials when `avatarUrl` is empty (all server contacts currently return `''`).
- Avatar goes in `shared/avatar`, matching the existing `shared/badge`. It does not go in `shared/ui/`.
- `contacts/**` uses client rendering: prerender would call the API at build time and cannot resolve `:contactId`.
- Excluded: related deals/tasks, advanced search, create/edit, check-email, "Advanced Search" link.
- Component name: `ContactDetailsPage` (request said `ContactDeails`).

**Further Considerations**
1. Client seed vs HttpClient: the store calls HttpClient, so `contacts-seed.ts` is unused at runtime unless a mock interceptor is added. Option A (recommended): server is the only runtime source; seed used only in specs. Option B: add a mock HTTP interceptor that serves the seed.
2. Card navigation: A (recommended) `contactSelected` output, page navigates (keeps card presentational per architecture doc). B: `routerLink` on the card.
3. Back link: A (recommended) plain `/contacts/search`, so `q` is lost. B: keep the last `q` (for example via `Location.back()` or a query param passed from search).
```

```
# Angular Rules

## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking
- Prefer type inference when the type is obvious
- Avoid the `any` type; use `unknown` when type is uncertain

## Angular Best Practices

- Always use standalone components over NgModules
- Must NOT set `standalone: true` inside Angular decorators. It's the default in Angular v20+.
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly. `OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+.
- Use signals for state management
- Implement lazy loading for feature routes
- Do NOT use the `@HostBinding` and `@HostListener` decorators. Put host bindings inside the `host` object of the `@Component` or `@Directive` decorator instead
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images.
  - `NgOptimizedImage` does not work for inline base64 images.

## Accessibility Requirements

- It MUST pass all AXE checks.
- It MUST follow all WCAG AA minimums, including focus management, color contrast, and ARIA attributes.

## Components

- Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility
- Use `input()` and `output()` functions instead of decorators
- Use `model()` for two-way bound properties with `[(prop)]` syntax instead of pairing `input()` with `output()`
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Use `linkedSignal()` for state derived from multiple reactive sources that must stay synchronized
- Expose visual variant dimensions as literal union inputs (for example `input<'new' | 'won'>()`) reflected to the DOM with `[attr.data-<name>]` in the `host` in @Component()
```

```
# Workflow Rules

## Code Generation

- Never create files by hand that an `ng g` schematic can generate.
- `ng g c <path>` already creates a folder named after the last segment. Pass the parent folder, not the folder plus name: `ng g c shared/badge` (creates `shared/badge/badge.ts`), not `ng g c shared/badge/badge` (creates `shared/badge/badge/badge.ts`).
- Do not change schematic flags unless the user asks. Let defaults come from `angular.json`.
- Prefer batch generation: prepare all needed `ng g` commands first, then run them together in one terminal call.

## Verification Order

- Format changed files with prettier: `npx prettier --write <files>`. Config is in `.prettierrc`.
- Type-check with `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json`.
- Lint changed files only: `npx eslint <files>`.
- Use the running `ng serve` session to check the build. Do not run `ng build` unless asked. If no session is running, ask before starting one.
- Fix only problems in changed files, or problems that stop `ng serve` from rebuilding.
- The editor's CSS linter reports `@theme` and `@apply` as errors. These are false positives from Tailwind at-rules.

## Browser Checks

- Ask before using `open_browser_page`, `click_element`, or any other browser tool to verify, debug, or fix.

## Scope

- Template-only requests: do not add logic beyond the `imports` array unless the user approves.
- Do not create markdown files to document changes unless requested.
```

```
# Architecture Rules

## Dependency Directions

- `app` may import from `core`, `shared`, and `features`.
- `core` may import from `shared` only.
- `features/<name>` may import from `shared` only, and from another feature only through that feature's `index.ts`.
- `shared` imports from no other layer in `src/app`.
- Forbidden: `features` to `core`, `core` to `features`, `shared` to `core` or `features`.

## Public API

- Import a module only through its `index.ts`, using its alias. Never import a deep file such as `features/deals/pages/...`.
- Inside one module, relative imports are allowed.
- Lazy routes load a feature through its alias, for example `import('@feature/deals')` (ADR-0004).

## Path Aliases

Defined in the `paths` of `tsconfig.json`.

| Alias             | Target                             |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `@core`           | `src/app/core/index.ts`            |
| `@shared`         | `src/app/shared/index.ts`          |
| `@feature/<name>` | `src/app/features/<name>/index.ts` |

- Alias names are fixed: `@core`, `@shared`, and `@feature/<name>`, where `<name>` is the feature folder name in kebab-case. Do not invent other aliases without the user's approval.
- Do not use wildcard mappings such as `@feature/*`. Sheriff reports them as SH-001 errors, so each feature has its own explicit entry.
- Across a module boundary, use the alias. Do not use `../` paths. For example, from `features/deals/` to shared code, use `@shared`, not `../../../shared`.
- Relative imports are allowed only inside the same module: the same `core`, the same `shared`, or the same `features/<name>` folder.
```

```
import { Component, computed, output, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { SharedImports } from '@shared';
import { TASK_PRIORITY_LABELS, TaskPriority } from '../../model/deal-task.model';

interface NewTaskDraft {
  title: string;
  priority: TaskPriority;
}

const emptyTask = (): NewTaskDraft => ({ title: '', priority: 'medium' });

@Component({
  selector: 'app-deal-task-composer',
  imports: [SharedImports, FormField],
  template: `
    <div class="flex items-end gap-3">
      <mat-form-field class="flex-1">
        <mat-label>New task</mat-label>
        <input matInput type="text" [formField]="taskForm.title" />
      </mat-form-field>
      <mat-form-field class="w-36">
        <mat-label>Priority</mat-label>
        <mat-select [formField]="taskForm.priority">
          @for (priority of priorities; track priority) {
            <mat-option [value]="priority">{{ priorityLabels[priority] }}</mat-option>
          }
        </mat-select>
      </mat-form-field>
      <button matButton="filled" type="button" [disabled]="!canSubmit()" (click)="submit()">
        Add
      </button>
    </div>
  `,
})
export class DealTaskComposer {
  readonly submitted = output<{ title: string; priority: TaskPriority }>();

  protected readonly priorityLabels = TASK_PRIORITY_LABELS;
  protected readonly priorities = Object.keys(TASK_PRIORITY_LABELS) as TaskPriority[];

  private readonly draft = signal<NewTaskDraft>(emptyTask());
  protected readonly taskForm = form(this.draft);
  protected readonly canSubmit = computed(() => this.draft().title.trim() !== '');

  protected submit(): void {
    const { title, priority } = this.draft();
    if (!title.trim()) return;

    this.submitted.emit({ title: title.trim(), priority });
    this.draft.set(emptyTask());
  }
}
```

```
  contacts: PagedContacts;
}

}
```

```
HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { inject, Service } from '@angular/core';
import { map, Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { Contact, ContactSearchResponse, PagedContacts } from '../model/contact.model';

@Service()
export class ContactsStore {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);

  search(q: string): Observable<PagedContacts> {
    return this.http
      .get<ContactSearchResponse>('contacts', { params: { q } })
      .pipe(map((response) => response.contacts));
  }

  getById(contactId: string): Observable<Contact> {
    return this.http.get<Contact>(`contacts/${encodeURIComponent(contactId)}`);
  }
```

```
, computed, input } from '@angular/core';

export type AvatarSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-avatar',
  styles: `
    :host {
      --avatar-size: 48px;
      --avatar-font-size: 1rem;
      display: inline-flex;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: var(--avatar-size);
      height: var(--avatar-size);
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background-color: var(--color-surface-container-high);
      color: var(--color-on-surface);
      font-size: var(--avatar-font-size);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    :host([data-size='sm']) {
      --avatar-size: 32px;
      --avatar-font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    :host([data-size='lg']) {
      --avatar-size: 80px;
      --avatar-font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    @if (src()) {
      <img [src]="src()" [alt]="name()" />
    } @else {
      <span aria-hidden="true">{{ initials() }}</span>
    }
  `,
  host: {
    '[attr.data-size]': 'size()',
  },
})
export class Avatar {
  readonly name = input.required<string>();
  readonly src = input<string>('');
  readonly size = input<AvatarSize>('md');

  protected readonly initials = computed(() =>
    this.name()
      .split(/\s+/)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .slice(0, 2)
      .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase())
      .join(''),
  );
```

```
, input, linkedSignal, output } from '@angular/core';
import { takeUntilDestroyed, toObservable } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { SharedForms } from '@shared';
import { debounceTime, distinctUntilChanged, map, skip } from 'rxjs';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contact-search-form',
  imports: [...SharedForms, FormField],
  template: `
    <form role="search" class="flex items-end gap-3" (submit)="onSubmit($event)">
      <mat-form-field class="flex-1">
        <mat-label>Search contacts</mat-label>
        <input matInput type="search" [formField]="searchForm.q" />
      </mat-form-field>
      <button matButton="filled" type="submit">Search</button>
    </form>
  `,
  host: {
    class: 'block',
  },
})
export class ContactSearchForm {
  readonly initialQuery = input<string>('');
  readonly queryChange = output<string>();

  // Resets when the URL query changes (e.g. browser back)
  private readonly draft = linkedSignal(() => ({ q: this.initialQuery() }));
  protected readonly searchForm = form(this.draft);

  constructor() {
    toObservable(this.draft)
      .pipe(
        map((draft) => draft.q.trim()),
        debounceTime(300),
        distinctUntilChanged(),
        skip(1), // first value is the initial query, already in the URL
        takeUntilDestroyed(),
      )
      .subscribe((q) => this.queryChange.emit(q));
  }

  protected onSubmit(event: Event): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    this.queryChange.emit(this.draft().q.trim());
  }
```

```
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ContactsStore } from '../../data/contacts.store';

import { ContactSearchForm } from '../../ui/contact-search-form/contact-search-form';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-contact-search-page',
  imports: [ContactCard, ContactSearchForm],
  template: `
    <main class="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-surface p-4 text-on-surface">
      <h1 class="text-title-lg">Contacts</h1>

      <app-contact-search-form [initialQuery]="q()" (queryChange)="onQueryChange($event)" />

      @if (searchResource.isLoading()) {
        <p class="text-body-md">Loading ...</p>
      }

      @if (errorMessage(); as message) {
        <p role="alert" class="text-body-md text-error">{{ message }}</p>
      }

      @if (!searchResource.isLoading() && !errorMessage() && contacts().length === 0) {
        <p class="text-body-md text-on-surface-variant">No contacts found.</p>
      }

      <ul class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        @for (contact of contacts(); track contact.id) {
          <li>
            <app-contact-card [contact]="contact" />
          </li>
        }
      </ul>
    </main>
  `,
})
export class ContactSearchPage {
  private readonly store = inject(ContactsStore);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly route = inject(ActivatedRoute);

  // Bound from the ?q= query param (withComponentInputBinding)
  readonly q = input<string>('');

  protected readonly searchResource = rxResource<PagedContacts, string>({
    params: () => this.q(),
    stream: ({ params: q }) => this.store.search(q),
  });

  protected readonly contacts = computed(() => this.searchResource.value()?.items ?? []);

  protected readonly errorMessage = computed(() => {
    const error = this.searchResource.error();
    if (!error) return null;
    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unexpected error';
  });

  // Keeps the search term in the URL; replaceUrl avoids a history entry per keystroke
  protected onQueryChange(q: string): void {
    this.router.navigate([], {
      relativeTo: this.route,
      queryParams: { q },
      replaceUrl: true,
    });
  }
```

```
# Angular Rules

## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking
- Prefer type inference when the type is obvious
- Avoid the `any` type; use `unknown` when type is uncertain

## Angular Best Practices

- Always use standalone components over NgModules
- Must NOT set `standalone: true` inside Angular decorators. It's the default in Angular v20+.
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly. `OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+.
- Use signals for state management
- Implement lazy loading for feature routes
- Do NOT use the `@HostBinding` and `@HostListener` decorators. Put host bindings inside the `host` object of the `@Component` or `@Directive` decorator instead
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images.
  - `NgOptimizedImage` does not work for inline base64 images.

## Accessibility Requirements

- It MUST pass all AXE checks.
- It MUST follow all WCAG AA minimums, including focus management, color contrast, and ARIA attributes.

## Components

- Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility
- Use `input()` and `output()` functions instead of decorators
- Use `model()` for two-way bound properties with `[(prop)]` syntax instead of pairing `input()` with `output()`
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Use `linkedSignal()` for state derived from multiple reactive sources that must stay synchronized
- Expose visual variant dimensions as literal union inputs (for example `input<'new' | 'won'>()`) reflected to the DOM with `[attr.data-<name>]` in the `host` in @Component()
```
